races.name: Human
races.description: The most common and adaptable people, found in every corner of the world.

traits.name: Versatility
traits.description: You begin with one additional tag skill.

traits.name: Ambition
traits.description: You may take one bonus perk at 1st level (any perk whose prerequisites you already meet).

races.name: Elf
races.description: Graceful, long-lived people with a deep connection to nature and magic. An abstract ancestry: play one of its subraces, not the generic elf.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 18 meters.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You resist charm and mind-affecting magic, and cannot be magically put to sleep.

races.name: Common Elf
races.description: The baseline playable elf. A subrace that overrides nothing — it inherits the elf parent's phase, speed, size, ability modifiers, and traits unchanged. Use this to play a 'plain' elf.

races.name: Green Elf
races.description: Forest-dwelling elves bound to the living wood. Inherits the elf base; speed and size carry over from the parent.

traits.name: Woodland Stride
traits.description: Difficult terrain of plants and undergrowth costs you no extra movement.

races.name: Black Elf
races.description: Subterranean elves of the lightless deeps. A subrace that OVERRIDES the elf phase (wood → water), showing how descent need not preserve every trait.

traits.name: Sunless Sight
traits.description: Your darkvision extends to 36 meters, but you have disadvantage on checks in bright sunlight.

traits.name: Shadowmeld
traits.description: +10 to stealth while in dim light or darkness.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Sturdy, industrious folk carved from the mountain stone itself. An abstract ancestry: play one of its subraces.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 18 meters.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You resist poison and disease, taking reduced damage from both.

races.name: Common Dwarf
races.description: The baseline playable dwarf. A subrace that overrides nothing — it inherits the dwarf parent's phase, speed, size, ability modifiers, and traits unchanged. Use this to play a 'plain' dwarf.

races.name: Hill Dwarf
races.description: Dwarves of the rolling foothills, closer to soil than ore. Inherits the dwarf base but OVERRIDES its phase (metal → earth).

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per level.

races.name: Mountain Dwarf
races.description: Dwarves of the high peaks and deep mines. Inherits the dwarf base, phase included.

traits.name: Mountain Armor Training
traits.description: You are proficient with light and medium armor.

races.name: Beastman
races.description: A TEMPLATE, not a race you play. It defines the shape of anthropomorphic beastfolk so users can author their own kin (catman, wolfman, ratman, …). Kin are SISTERS: each declares its own phase, attributes, speed, size, and traits, and need share nothing mechanical with the others — only the template's shape and the 'beastfolk' kinship.

traits.name: Beastfolk
traits.description: Marks the race as beastfolk. A kin typically defines natural-weapon and heightened-sense traits, but no values are inherited from the template or from sibling kin.

races.name: Catman
races.description: An agile feline beastfolk. A kin of the beastman template — fully self-defined, sharing nothing mechanical with other beastfolk.

traits.name: Retractable Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons dealing 1d6 slashing damage.

traits.name: Cat's Landing
traits.description: You take no damage from falls of 6 meters or less and always land on your feet.

races.name: Wolfman
races.description: A wild, pack-bonded lupine beastfolk. A sister kin to the catman with an entirely different phase, attributes, and traits — the template imposes shape, not commonality.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: +10 to attack checks against a foe that an ally is also engaging.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: +10 to detection checks that rely on scent.
